run_identify_language: run identify_language to detect the spoken language of an audio file via the OpenAI SDK and vLLM
run_identify_language_raw: run identify_language_raw to detect language of an audio file using raw HTTP requests without the OpenAI SDK
run_identify_language_streaming: run identify_language_streaming to detect language of an audio file via SSE streaming endpoint
run_main_lid_client: run main to batch-identify languages of audio files using both sync and streaming APIs
test_identify_language: test identify_language with an audio file path, OpenAI client instance, and model name
